introduction: The Ravenloft Catacombs weave independent prisoner rescues, relic recovery, fortune commissions and three Strahd-skull reward choices through a large network of crypts. Follow the contacts you encounter and keep their competing proofs and availability in mind. Player journal progress requires active, ready accounting.
orientation: Enter through Castle Ravenloft's cellar or Kingsmen route, or push the paired handprints between Ravenloft and the catacomb wine-cellar passage. These are world access mechanisms; discovering or reading about them does not record successful travel.

The black key carried by Stefania fits the cell doors and supplies Emil's release. The old Castle Ravenloft key fits the main gates and hidden wall route; it has a 100 break chance. The image of Rahadin replaces it and awards a separately brittle spectral key for the spectral corridor.

Pull the iron curtains for Thredra's laboratory route and push the broken wine racks for the cellar passage. Bring Thredra three different holy relics together for a buckler and stake; her relic delivery retires her.

Dostron's ashes can restore Exethanter's narrated memory or rejuvenate Thredra for a different reward. Neither route is required by the other. Identical slab/remains prototypes use a shared container lookup, so the intended crypt placement of several relics needs live qualification.

The bleeding slab opens the Amber Temple passage. Kasimir accepts the altar's blood of Zhudun for a key to Patrina's crypt and three moonbeam drops. The existing banshee and Kasimir corpse do not prove a resurrection event.

Rahadin offers eight independent proof requests. Each supplies one physical spectral fortune coin; these items are distinct from wallet currency. Proofs drawn from Ezmerelda, Rictavio or Jander compete with keeping those contacts available for their good-aligned skull rewards.

Each favor commission requires five fortune coins and one exact role scroll together. The animated cloak carries four different scrolls and also has a shop role. Active accounting currently blocks buying; supplied existing scrolls still qualify. Native giving enforces no class or faction prerequisite.

Fortune services consume one coin for potions or equipment chests plus cash and experience. These remain visible support deliveries without extra achievements. Ezmerelda's paid card reading and Izek's paid dues use wallet offerings and remain unavailable under active accounting.

Ezmerelda's twelve card faces form a conversational loop: raven, moon and mists lead through blood, rose and chalice to bat, mirror and gate, then castle, coffin and candelabra return to the opening faces. Replies are stateless; keywords do not complete quest steps or establish a paid reading session.

Blinsky accepts any one of five exact clockwork artifacts as a single recovery request. His stocked toy woman supports a separate Izek request. Izek also accepts two different wines and Ireena's comb for distinct rewards; his toy reward key has no confirmed door or container target.

Wolf, human, bat and gaseous Strahd forms are independently reset creatures. The wolf statuette, two memory switches, dimension door and coffin mechanisms provide alternate passage routes. The gaseous form carries the exact skull; receipt does not prove a personal kill or a sequence of transformations.

Choose a skull recipient: Ezmerelda, Rictavio or Jander. Their equipment rewards differ, and each contact disappears after delivery. Promised room keys, restored sunshine, party departure and permanent liberation are not corresponding native outputs or recorded world changes.

Explore the crypt names, coffin-and-lid escape switches, Tomescu's Blood Rift portals, Sergei's portcullis and marble sword, and Dhavit's speech door. Say dhavit from the northern side or utherlan from the southern side to unlock that door, then open it. Some Blood Rift portals release enemies instead of transporting you.

Sasha's journal describes the Dayheart and Sunsword as history and intended vampire preparation. It is optional lore, without a verified Dayheart destruction or Sunsword quest outcome. One skeleton search mechanism targets an absent exit, and Sasha's alternate epitaph switch has no ordinary placement; those routes need builder repair.

Carry all offering items directly. Readiness and optional earlier receipts award nothing. Eighteen repeatable story/request groups are potential daily candidates; mode-zero disappearing contacts are story-only. Daily eligibility does not promise available stock or contacts. Active source-generation support must be qualified for a playable journey.

contacts.name: Exethanter
contacts.description: Exethanter wanders from the Amber Temple holding passage. Ask about his name and the crypts; Dostron is addressed by the native spelling dostran. His ash exchange and Thredra's ash exchange are independent choices.

contacts.name: Emil the Barovian
contacts.description: Emil is the shackled Barovian in the keyed cells. Stefania's black key supplies his rescue; his werewolf departure is narrated.

contacts.name: Thredra Anarax
contacts.description: Thredra offers holy-relic and ash outcomes plus a fortune service. Her relic exchange retires her, so choose contact order carefully. The chanting word eugszr is an addressable response rather than a recorded spell.

contacts.name: Kasimir Velikov
contacts.description: Kasimir offers the blood-of-Zhudun rescue story and a separate fortune service. His rescue retires him; the already stocked corpse and banshee in Patrina's crypt are independent world data.

contacts.name: a Vistani wagoner
contacts.description: The Vistani wagoner provides road, rumor and vampire guidance without a native terminal delivery.

contacts.name: Ezmerelda D'avenir
contacts.description: Ezmerelda explains Vistani culture and twelve stateless card faces, offers an unsupported paid reading, and accepts the Strahd skull. Rahadin also requests her dagger; these routes share contact availability.

contacts.name: Rahadin
contacts.description: Rahadin exchanges eight independent proofs for physical fortune coins, then offers four separate five-coin favor commissions. Printed invitations, court roles and vampire imagery do not establish faction membership.

contacts.name: Gadof Blinsky
contacts.description: Gadof Blinsky roams from the toyshop toward Barovia. One of five artifacts satisfies his recovery request. His carried toy woman can be sold by legacy shopping, though it is not replenishing shop stock; purchases are blocked under active accounting.

contacts.name: Rictavio
contacts.description: Rictavio can roam through the Ravenloft approach. His Strahd-skull reward differs from the other two recipients, and Rahadin accepts his bonnet as an independent proof.

contacts.name: Izek Strazni
contacts.description: Izek offers distinct wine, comb and toy requests, a fortune service and unsupported paid dues. His reward key has no confirmed access target. Use the native topic breech for his castle-breach response.

contacts.name: Cyrus Belview
contacts.description: Cyrus Belview trades one fortune coin for four equipment chests, cash and experience, then disappears. This is a service rather than a separate story achievement.

contacts.name: an image of Rahadin
contacts.description: The image of Rahadin in the spectral corridor replaces the old catacomb key and awards the spectral key, then disappears. The old key and spectral key both have a 100 break chance.

contacts.name: Jander Sunstar
contacts.description: Jander offers a distinct Strahd-skull finale and raw-ant-pincer food service. Rahadin requests his Oathbow, so proof recovery and later availability need a conscious route choice.

contacts.name: a spectre of "Stefania"
contacts.description: Stefania's spectre carries the black cell key needed by Emil. Possession does not prove a personal kill or a successful unlocking journey.

contacts.name: Rahadin's animated cloak
contacts.description: The animated cloak follows Rahadin with four different favor scrolls and also has a fixed-room shop role. Purchases are unavailable under active accounting; existing supplied stock remains valid for favor commissions.

contacts.name: &-wPidlwick II
contacts.description: Pidlwick II carries the exact clockwork artifact Blinsky accepts and roams from a release passage.

contacts.name: a miniature wind-up gnome
contacts.description: This specific windup gnome carries Blinsky's required artifact. The many other windup gnomes do not share that stock.

contacts.name: a GIANT spider
contacts.description: The giant spider carries the chelicerae requested by Rahadin and has a roaming release route.

contacts.name: the Gulthias tree
contacts.description: Gulthias carries Rahadin's heart proof and can roam through foreign forest, castle and Barovia routes.

contacts.name: the giant ant queen
contacts.description: The ant queen in the burrow carries a heavy eggsac for Rahadin and raw pincers for Jander. These are distinct requests.

contacts.name: Count Strahd (dire wolf form)
contacts.description: Strahd's wolf form carries a wolf statuette and a memory switch. The configured get and touch mechanisms open release passages; the form is an independent reset placement.

contacts.name: Count Strahd (human form)
contacts.description: Strahd's human form carries a second memory switch. Its configured touch target opens a passage; no reviewed death transformation creates the other forms.

contacts.name: Count Strahd (bat form)
contacts.description: Strahd's bat form carries the dimension-door object. Entering is a teleport mechanism requiring its own committed-travel qualification.

contacts.name: Count Strahd (gaseous form)
contacts.description: Strahd's gaseous form carries the crypt key and exact skull. It is independent reset stock, not verified lineage from a player killing the human form.

contacts.name: the banshee of Patrina Velikovna
contacts.description: Patrina's banshee is already placed in her crypt behind the reforged-key door. This placement and Kasimir's already stocked corpse do not prove successful resurrection.

stories.title: Emil's Release
stories.summary: Bring Emil the black key carried by Stefania to receive the key back and up to 1,000,000 experience. Emil disappears after the accepted rescue. His werewolf departure and reunion are narrated rather than recorded transformations.

steps.hint: Stefania's spectre carries this key in her cell. It fits the keyed cell doors, including Emil's; unlocking and entering are access preparation, without a separate completion event.

steps.text: Bring the black key to Emil
steps.hint: Carry every offering directly, outside equipment and containers. Supplied exact materials qualify without personal recovery history. The returned key is a newly created replacement of the same kind. Receiving it does not preserve the original object identity or prove personal recovery from Stefania.

stories.title: Exethanter's Lost Memory
stories.summary: Bring Dostron's ashes to Exethanter for the phylactery. The lich disappears after delivery. His restored memory, golden figure and journey to Vallaki are narrated; no separate revived king or linked onward quest is established.

steps.hint: The reset declares these ashes inside a marble slab in Dostron's crypt. Repeated slab instances use a shared container lookup, so the declared room needs live placement qualification. Thredra accepts the same ashes for a different outcome.

Carry every offering directly, outside equipment and containers. Supplied exact materials qualify without personal recovery history. Seek Exethanter through the Amber Temple route. No matching door or container destination for his phylactery was found in the reviewed world; breaking it is a narrated instruction, not a confirmed objective.

stories.title: Thredra's Holy Relics
stories.summary: Bring three different relics together: the shroud, fingerbone and thighbone. Thredra awards the buckler of the Saints and a sharpened crucifix stake, then disappears. Three copies of one relic do not substitute.

steps.hint: The reset declares the shroud inside mummified remains in Ravenovia's coffin. Several remains share the same prototype; container placement needs live qualification.
The fingerbone is declared inside the mirror in Tomescu's hidden bedchamber. His misty portal and Blood Rift passages are separate access puzzles.
The thighbone is declared in the marble slab in Markovia's crypt. The shared lookup among repeated slabs needs qualification.

steps.text: Deliver all three holy relics to Thredra
steps.hint: Carry every offering directly, outside equipment and containers. Supplied exact materials qualify without personal recovery history. The stake is suggested preparation for the Strahd story. The later skull deliveries do not require this earlier receipt, the stake, or a recorded stake attack.

stories.title: Thredra's Rejuvenation
stories.summary: Bring Dostron's ashes to Thredra for the ring of the Dire Lantern. Her youth and departure are narrated without a transformed replacement NPC; this exchange does not retire her. Exethanter offers a different outcome for the same ashes.

steps.hint: These are the same ashes requested by Exethanter, declared in Dostron's marble slab. One spent object cannot be handed to both contacts; supplied or later available copies can support independent deliveries.

Carry every offering directly, outside equipment and containers. Supplied exact materials qualify without personal recovery history. Thredra's relic exchange retires her, while this ash exchange does not. Consider contact availability when choosing the order of independent requests.

stories.title: Kasimir's Sister
stories.summary: Bring Kasimir the blood of Zhudun for a reforged key and three drops of moonbeam, then he disappears. His planned rescue of Patrina is narrated; Patrina's banshee and a stocked Kasimir corpse already exist independently in her crypt.

steps.hint: The vial is placed on the Amber Temple altar. The bleeding slab opens the temple passage. Possessing or drinking the vial does not record a resurrection; its configured potion effects are aura spells.

steps.text: Deliver the blood of Zhudun to Kasimir
steps.hint: Carry every offering directly, outside equipment and containers. Supplied exact materials qualify without personal recovery history. The reforged key fits Patrina's crypt. The key opens access after this delivery; the pre-existing corpse, staff, medallion and moonbeam drops do not prove a successful resurrection episode.
